missing_evidence: Postgres server-side metrics: active/max connections, wait events, saturation over the incident window
Order service pool configuration and pool wait/acquire timeout metrics
candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order ReadTimeouts and gateway /v1/checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show pool idle=0 and DependencyUnavailable, but no Postgres-side saturation metrics confirm exhaustion versus slow queries or DB outage.

report.explanation: All three checkout traces fail at postgres.save_order with pool size 5, idle 0, DependencyUnavailable; order calls time out and gateway returns 502 (16/60s on /v1/checkout, p95 2425ms). Inventory and payment succeed, localizing the fault to the order-to-postgres path. Pool exhaustion is the best-supported taxonomy cause; DB-side saturation metrics are still needed to confirm.
